# Carlos Alves Consulting

> Automating weekly reports, dashboards and forecasts for UK hospitality and health & wellness operators — built in your spreadsheets, no subscriptions.

Independent Data & AI Consultant helping UK catering and hospitality businesses and health & wellness businesses replace retyped weekly reports, with reporting automation built in your spreadsheets. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute Weekly-Report Walkthrough.

## Pages

- [Carlos Alves Consulting](https://carlosalves.uk/): Costs, orders and sales in one weekly report. No retyping. Independent Data & AI consultancy for UK hospitality and health & wellness businesses: reporting automation, KPI dashboards, invoice reconciliation and forecasting — built in the spreadsheets you already use.
- [Hospitality & Catering](https://carlosalves.uk/hospitality-catering/): Automating weekly reports, dashboards and forecasts for UK catering and hospitality businesses — built in your spreadsheets, no subscriptions.
- [Health & Wellness](https://carlosalves.uk/health-wellness/): Weekly reporting automation for UK clinics, dental practices, gyms, care providers and wellness practitioners — built in your spreadsheets, no subscriptions.
- [Booking confirmation](https://carlosalves.uk/confirmation/): The page a visitor sees after booking a walkthrough — what happens next, Google Meet, and email.
- [How can a gym reconcile cash and bank-transfer payments with its gym software without marking each one by hand?](https://carlosalves.uk/gym-non-card-payments-reconcile/): Most gym software can already hold non-card payments: you record the payment as an offline method (cash or bank transfer) against the member, then confirm…
- [What CRM should a wedding and events venue use to track leads, quotes, payments and revenue forecasts?](https://carlosalves.uk/wedding-venue-crm-payments-forecasting/): A venue whose list includes pipelines, quotes, e-signed contracts, payment chasing, a shared events calendar and a couple portal is usually describing…
- [What restaurant payroll software can handle tips for both restaurants without eating Monday?](https://carlosalves.uk/restaurant-payroll-software-tips/): If Monday is spent calculating and paying tips across two restaurants, you need payroll or tip-management software that can run a tronc or tip pool and feed those figures into payroll.
- [Bar owners who moved off the spreadsheet: what did they go with?](https://carlosalves.uk/bar-owners-moved-off-spreadsheet/): It depends which job the spreadsheet was doing.
- [How can a restaurant keep tip pooling without calculating it by hand, and get a clean export into payroll?](https://carlosalves.uk/restaurant-tip-pooling-payroll-export/): Yes: a pooled-tips calculation can be set up once as written rules (who is in the pool, how points or hours split it) and then refreshed from your till and timesheet exports, producing an import-ready file for payroll each pay run instead of a hand-worked report.
- [What should a restaurant wage forecast spreadsheet include, and how do you stop retyping it every week?](https://carlosalves.uk/restaurant-wage-forecast-spreadsheet/): A useful weekly wage forecast spreadsheet has four columns per day: forecast sales, forecast wages from the rota, actual sales and actual wages, so it shows wage cost as a percentage of sales for the week and the year to date against your target.
- [What should a weekly multi-site hospitality scorecard show, and is there a template?](https://carlosalves.uk/hospitality-weekly-multi-site-scorecard/): A weekly multi-site scorecard works best as one row per site and one column per measure: sales against budget and forecast, wage cost as a percentage of sales, sales mix, and gross margin, with the week and the year to date side by side and a consistent format for every site.
- [What inventory solution works for an independent restaurant without becoming a chore?](https://carlosalves.uk/independent-restaurant-inventory-tools/): For an independent restaurant, the choice is between a dedicated inventory platform, which MarketMan for example says covers counts, invoice capture, purchasing and recipe costing, and a stock-count spreadsheet that refreshes from your supplier invoices and till sales so the weekly count turns straight into food and drink cost.
- [How can a multi-location gym owner forecast cash and see margins by location without a finance team?](https://carlosalves.uk/gym-financial-forecasting-multi-location/): Start from the bookkeeping you already have and build a simple weekly or monthly model per location: membership income from your gym software, costs from your accounts, and a 12-month forecast of members, revenue, costs and cash, with burn rate and margin shown for each site and in total.

## Case studies

- [Harbour & Vine](https://carlosalves.uk/hospitality-catering/): Three neighbourhood restaurants in London. Illustrative example of weekly reporting automation, invoice matching, food-cost and waste tracking.
- [Fernwell Wellness](https://carlosalves.uk/health-wellness/): Four locations in Manchester, Leeds and Sheffield offering physiotherapy, massage and reformer Pilates. Illustrative example of appointment, staffing and cost reporting.
- All figures, statistics and data in these case studies are entirely fictitious sample data created for illustrative purposes only. No real customer information, personal data or confidential records are used, displayed or processed.
